messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- Dawn broke
- Upon the earth
- With iron hands
- And fire
- The old age
- Died screaming
- In smoke
- While empires fell
- Like dry leaves
- Into dust
- Men built towers
- Of steel
- That scraped heaven
- Yet shattered easily
- Against truth
- Wars raged
- Across continents
- Bathing soil
- In red
- Blood flowed
- Like rivers
- To the sea
- Peace was promised
- Then broken
- Again and again
- Until hope
- Faded fast
- But light
- Returned slowly
- Through cracks
